verses.original: πάλαι Πολυμερῶς καὶ πολυτρόπως ὁ Θεὸς λαλήσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἐν τοῖς προφήταις
verses.transliteration: palai Polymerōs kai polytropōs ho Theos lalēsas tois patrasin en tois prophētais
verses.literal: {On many} past occasions and in many different ways - God spoke to [our] fathers through the prophets

verses.original: ἐπ’ τούτων ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν Υἱῷ ὃν ἔθηκεν κληρονόμον πάντων καὶ δι’ οὗ ἐποίησεν τοὺς αἰῶνας
verses.transliteration: ep’ toutōn eschatou tōn hēmerōn elalēsen hēmin en Huiō hon ethēken klēronomon pantōn kai di’ hou epoiēsen tous aiōnas
verses.literal: But in these last - days He has spoken to us by [His] Son whom He appointed heir of all things and through whom He made the universe

verses.original: ὃς ὢν ἀπαύγασμα τῆς δόξης καὶ χαρακτὴρ τῆς αὐτοῦ ὑποστάσεως τε φέρων τὰ πάντα τῷ τῆς αὐτοῦ δυνάμεως ῥήματι δι’ ποιησάμενος καθαρισμὸν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τῆς Μεγαλωσύνης ἐν ὑψηλοῖς
verses.transliteration: hos ōn apaugasma tēs doxēs kai charaktēr tēs autou hypostaseōs te pherōn ta panta tō tēs autou dynameōs rhēmati di’ poiēsamenos katharismon tōn hamartiōn ekathisen en dexia tēs Megalōsynēs en hypsēlois
verses.literal: [The Son] is [the] radiance of [God’s] glory and [the] exact representation of His nature - upholding - all things by vvv His powerful word [After] He had provided purification - for sins He sat down at [the] right hand of the Majesty on high

verses.original: γενόμενος τοσούτῳ κρείττων τῶν ἀγγέλων ὅσῳ ὄνομα κεκληρονόμηκεν διαφορώτερον παρ’ αὐτοὺς
verses.transliteration: genomenos tosoutō kreittōn tōn angelōn hosō onoma keklēronomēken diaphorōteron par’ autous
verses.literal: [So] He became as far superior to the angels as [the] name He has inherited [is] excellent beyond theirs

verses.original: γὰρ Τίνι τῶν ἀγγέλων ποτε εἶπέν σύ εἶ μου Υἱός σήμερον ἐγὼ γεγέννηκά σε Καὶ πάλιν Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς Πατέρα καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς Υἱόν
verses.transliteration: gar Tini tōn angelōn pote eipen sy ei mou Huios sēmeron egō gegennēka se Kai palin Egō esomai autō eis Patera kai autos estai moi eis Huion
verses.literal: For to which of the angels vvv did [God] ever say You are My Son today I have become Your Father . . . [Or] again I will be His - Father and He will be My - Son

verses.original: δὲ πάλιν Ὅταν εἰσαγάγῃ τὸν πρωτότοκον εἰς τὴν οἰκουμένην λέγει Καὶ πάντες Θεοῦ ἄγγελοι προσκυνησάτωσαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de palin Hotan eisagagē ton prōtotokon eis tēn oikoumenēn legei Kai pantes Theou angeloi proskynēsatōsan autō
verses.literal: And again when [God] brings [His] firstborn into the world He says - {Let} all God’s angels worship Him

verses.original: Καὶ μὲν πρὸς τοὺς ἀγγέλους λέγει Ὁ ποιῶν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἀγγέλους πνεύματα καὶ αὐτοῦ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς φλόγα πυρὸς
verses.transliteration: Kai men pros tous angelous legei Ho poiōn autou tous angelous pneumata kai autou tous leitourgous phloga pyros
verses.literal: Now . . . about the angels He says He makes His - angels winds - His - servants flames of fire

verses.original: δὲ Πρὸς τὸν Υἱόν σου Ὁ θρόνος ὁ Θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς εὐθύτητος ῥάβδος τῆς σου βασιλείας
verses.transliteration: de Pros ton Huion sou Ho thronos ho Theos eis ton aiōna tou aiōnos kai hē rhabdos tēs euthytētos rhabdos tēs sou basileias
verses.literal: But about the Son [He says] Your - throne O God [endures] forever . . . . . . vvv and ever and - - - justice [is] the scepter of Your kingdom

verses.original: ἠγάπησας δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐμίσησας ἀνομίαν διὰ τοῦτο ὁ Θεός σου ὁ Θεός ἔχρισέν σε παρὰ σου τοὺς μετόχους ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως
verses.transliteration: ēgapēsas dikaiosynēn kai emisēsas anomian dia touto ho Theos sou ho Theos echrisen se para sou tous metochous elaion agalliaseōs
verses.literal: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness therefore . . . - God Your - God has anointed You above Your - companions with [the] oil of joy

verses.original: Καί κατ’ ἀρχάς Κύριε Σὺ ἐθεμελίωσας τὴν γῆν καὶ οἱ οὐρανοί εἰσιν ἔργα τῶν σού χειρῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai kat’ archas Kyrie Sy ethemeliōsas tēn gēn kai hoi ouranoi eisin erga tōn sou cheirōn
verses.literal: And In [the] beginning O Lord You laid the foundations of the earth and the heavens are [the] work of Your hands

verses.original: αὐτοὶ ἀπολοῦνται δὲ σὺ διαμένεις καὶ πάντες παλαιωθήσονται ὡς ἱμάτιον
verses.transliteration: autoi apolountai de sy diameneis kai pantes palaiōthēsontai hōs himation
verses.literal: They will perish but You remain - vvv they will all wear out like a garment

verses.original: καὶ ἑλίξεις αὐτούς ὡσεὶ περιβόλαιον καὶ ὡς ἱμάτιον ἀλλαγήσονται δὲ σὺ εἶ ὁ αὐτὸς καὶ σου τὰ ἔτη οὐκ ἐκλείψουσιν
verses.transliteration: kai helixeis autous hōsei peribolaion kai hōs himation allagēsontai de sy ei ho autos kai sou ta etē ouk ekleipsousin
verses.literal: - You will roll them up . . . like a robe - like a garment they will be changed but You remain the same and Your - years vvv will never end

verses.original: δὲ Πρὸς τίνα τῶν ἀγγέλων ποτε εἴρηκέν Κάθου ἐκ μου δεξιῶν ἕως ἂν θῶ σου τοὺς ἐχθρούς ὑποπόδιον τῶν σου ποδῶν
verses.transliteration: de Pros tina tōn angelōn pote eirēken Kathou ek mou dexiōn heōs an thō sou tous echthrous hypopodion tōn sou podōn
verses.literal: Yet to which of the angels vvv did [God] ever say Sit at My right hand until . . . I make Your - enemies a footstool for Your feet

verses.original: εἰσὶν Οὐχὶ πάντες λειτουργικὰ πνεύματα ἀποστελλόμενα εἰς διακονίαν διὰ τοὺς μέλλοντας κληρονομεῖν σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: eisin Ouchi pantes leitourgika pneumata apostellomena eis diakonian dia tous mellontas klēronomein sōtērian
verses.literal: Are not [the angels] ministering spirits sent - to serve . . . those who will inherit salvation
